constructor_contract.input: Each fixed integer d>=3; even n>=n0(d); full adjacency output, no local oracle or joint-polynomial n,d promise
stages: Early pairing minimizes discounted structural/trace/entry/row accounts over O_d(n^2) candidate pairs for O_d(n) steps while retaining both signed precisions.
Cleanup uses prescribed first stubs and eligible clean partners until l0, maintaining separation and analytic caps.

Separated boundary completes using one smoothly tapered stop reference and exact Woodbury continuation; phaseA reduces row energy before phaseB entry control; only final l3 stubs can be matched arbitrarily.

Exact repair needs confinement, all-vertex local mass and typical bulk blocks, then biased simultaneous switches and prime-field seed enumeration; final exact spectral certificate does not replace these stages.
constructor_contract.parameter_hierarchy: a=10^-4; l0~n^(2/3+.15a),b=ceil(n^(1/3+.345a)),l1=l0+2b,l2=l0*n^(-g-r),l3=n^chi; rP=.001a permitted,g=r sufficiently small, g+r<<chi<rP; high fixed moments/diagram cutoff after specified drift constants. These qualitative inequalities are not instantiated numeric finite admission.

literal_auxiliary_group.meaning: Tracked largest-primary auxiliary points during early/cleanup, before label multiplicities. This is a literal source bookkeeping count, not a benchmark or unconditional memory/time lower bound; streaming/optimized representations were not ruled out.

cost_terms: O_d(n^2) pairing candidates times O_d(n) steps, with exact candidate inverses/statistics and account comparisons.
Rational matrix dimension O_d(n), path recurrence O_d(logn), polynomial-bit determinant/minor arithmetic and discounts; exponent and fixed orders still require choices.
Colorful bounded-treewidth DP on O_d(logn) vertices and exp(k)*k^O(logk)*logn hash family, not brute-force n^k embeddings.
Repair rational inertia cutoff search; Bernstein degree ceil(n^(2(c+C))) for Lf<=n^c,target n^-C; fixed c,C not numerically instantiated.
M=ceil(n^(1/3+10a)) vertex-disjoint switches; prime P~n^Cprime with Cprime sufficiently large; up to P^2 seeds and exact rational spectral verification per retained candidate.
constructor_contract.spectral_certificate: For separately checked simple dregular A, B=[e1-en,...,e(n-1)-en]; B^T(4(d-1)I-A^2)B positive definite iff all eigenvalues on1perp are strictly inside the two-sided tree bound. Generic exact verifier, not a constructor.
finite_missing: numeric n0(d) meeting all large-n inequalities
fully instantiated moment,loss,precision and prime exponents and all hidden constants
a finite graph/workload satisfying the complete input contract within a declared resource budget

old_baseline_contract.theorem: Alon2021Theorem1.3: each fixed d>=3,epsilon>0,all sufficiently large admissible n with nd even, full deterministic graph, absolute nontrivial spectrum<=2sqrt(d-1)+epsilon.
old_baseline_contract.finite_construction: Proof1.3 takes r=ceil(2/epsilon),s=2r+4 and a slightly larger H on n+u vertices,u=o(n),spectral error epsilon/2, every s-neighborhood at most one cycle. Lemma3.1 supplies at least |V(H)|/(2*d^(2r+3)) eligible vertices with cycle-free r+1 neighborhoods and pairwise distances>=2r+3. Delete u of them and match their neighbors to restore degree; parity nd,(n+u)d even gives ud even.
old_baseline_contract.finite_admission: Need u<=the eligible-set lower bound and the MOP near-size/local-cycle construction at this n; for the theorem these hold at sufficiently large n. No numeric threshold or complete executable old builder established here.
old_baseline_contract.same_contract: For source even n,nd is admissible. Choose epsilon<d-2sqrt(d-1) to make the old absolute bound<d,excluding disconnected/bipartite cases as well; it does not yield the exact strict tree threshold.
old_baseline_contract.alternatives: Seeded random regular or old arithmetic exact graphs at actually shared degree/order remain controls. Do not replace prescribed n by Theta(n),drop simplicity,exclude -d,or omit construction costs.

consensus_inference.workload_preserved: Unweighted nonlazy synchronous x(t+1)=A*x(t)/d, relativeL2 residual1e-6, same order/degree and frozen initial vectors.
consensus_inference.spectral_statement: r=||A|1perp||/d bounds worst-case error contraction; for0<r<1,ceil(log(delta)/log(r)) is a sufficient worst-case round count. It is not an observed mean round count.
consensus_inference.no_uniform_10percent: New strict bound only gives r<2sqrt(d-1)/d,with no fixed margin. Old upper bound approaches the same value as epsilon->0; upper-bound comparison supplies neither actual old lower bounds nor a uniform10percent reduction. Keep the original empirical prediction unchanged.
consensus_inference.total_cost: Include every construction phase, certificate and communication operation for both new and old builders. Existing graph reuse/amortization requires a separately frozen workload,not a silent exclusion.
